technique_name: Make a wallet friendly dish using the following ingredients: potatoes, zucchini, tomatoes, and peppers.
description: One possible recipe could be to make a vegan pizza with potatoes, zucchini, tomatoes, and peppers. Start by preheating the oven to 375 degrees. Cut the potatoes, zucchini, tomatoes, and peppers into cubes, and then spread them to a single layer on a greased baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes. After the vegetables are done baking, transfer them to a large bowl. In a separate bowl, mix 1/4 cup olive oil and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
